description: This file defines the ChartColor class, which encapsulates the properties and methods related to colors used in spreadsheet charts within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes constants for color types, properties for color attributes, and methods to set and retrieve these attributes.

classes.name: ChartColor
classes.description: Represents a color in a chart, supporting different color types and properties such as value, alpha transparency, and brightness.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ChartColor object, either from an array of properties or individual property values.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the color value as a string.

methods.name: setColorProperties
methods.description: Sets multiple color properties based on input parameters, determining types from string patterns.

methods.name: setColorPropertiesArray
methods.description: Sets color properties from an associative array.

methods.name: isUsable
methods.description: Checks if the color object has valid type and value for usage.

methods.name: getColorProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific color property by name.

methods.name: alphaToXml
methods.description: Converts an alpha value to its XML string representation.

methods.name: alphaFromXml
methods.description: Converts an XML alpha string back to an integer alpha value.
